dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: There is a fayth inside. And fiends.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Wait. This is the place, ya? Where you and her...

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Yes.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Her who?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: The first summoner I guarded. She died in there.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: The fayth was taken from a temple. Long ago.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: No fayth, no training. No training, no Final Aeon.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: So whoever stole it saved somebody. Good.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: ...Can't say I hate that.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Unsent.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: ...Lady Ginnem.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: You know her?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: I was her guardian. Her only one.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: I was too young to keep her alive.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: She won't let me send her.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Then there's nothing left of her to ask.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: No. There is one thing left.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: I still owe her a guardian.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Stand back, Yuna. This one is mine.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: She's gone. Truly, this time.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: I thought this would hurt more.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: You were good, Lu. You were really good.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Wakka.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: I'm just sayin'. Stronger than before, ya?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Perhaps.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Were you with her the whole way?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Not the whole way. That was the problem.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: You finished it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Yes. I did.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: I was supposed to finish it THEN!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: ...Go on, Yuna. The fayth is waiting for you.
